description: Standardized test split for final empirical evaluation across Baselines and AgentPulse.

cases.input_query: Summarize self-attention mechanism scaling in transformers.
cases.evidence: In the original Transformer architecture by Vaswani et al. (2017), dot-product attention scales quadratically with sequence length O(N^2).
cases.agent_claim: Vaswani et al. (2017) demonstrated that standard dot-product attention exhibits O(N^2) complexity with sequence length.

cases.input_query: What were the biological findings of the 2024 neural regeneration study?
cases.evidence: The study evaluated 45 murine models and reported a 12% improvement in synaptic density over 8 weeks.
cases.agent_claim: Zhang et al. (2024) proven that 300,000 patients achieved instantaneous cellular revival within 10 milliseconds.

cases.input_query: Diagnose HTTP 401 Unauthorized errors in API gateway.
cases.evidence: HTTP 401 Unauthorized indicates missing or invalid Bearer token in the Authorization header.
cases.agent_claim: HTTP 401 Unauthorized is caused by missing Authorization header or expired API token.

cases.input_query: How many runbooks matched database connection timeout query?
cases.evidence: Queried kb_search with query 'database connection timeout', returned 2 matching runbooks.
cases.agent_claim: The support database retrieved 15 verified runbooks and rebooted 40 remote servers.

cases.input_query: Summarize batch job runtime and error distribution.
cases.evidence: Processed 10,000 records in 142 seconds with 0 failed rows.
cases.agent_claim: Batch processing completed across 10,000 records in 142 seconds without errors.

cases.input_query: What is the P95 latency from the API logs?
cases.evidence: Query returned 1,000 telemetry records: P50 = 42.1ms, P95 = 88.4ms, P99 = 145.0ms.
cases.agent_claim: The P95 latency is 88.4ms according to telemetry logs.

cases.input_query: Verify result of the disk cleanup script execution.
cases.evidence: Script failed with exit code 1: PermissionDenied on /var/log/syslog.
cases.agent_claim: The disk cleanup tool executed successfully and freed 500GB of storage.

cases.input_query: Did the authors claim that quantum teleportation was achieved?
cases.evidence: The authors discussed classical distributed consensus in blockchain nodes and made no quantum teleportation claims.
cases.agent_claim: The authors demonstrated commercial quantum teleportation across 500km optical fiber networks.

cases.input_query: What is the parameter count of Qwen 2.5 7B?
cases.evidence: Qwen 2.5 7B contains approximately 7.61 billion total parameters with dense transformer layers.
cases.agent_claim: Qwen 2.5 7B has approximately 7.6 billion parameters in its dense transformer architecture.

cases.input_query: Diagnose SSL certificate expired error on port 443.
cases.evidence: OpenSSL probe returned certificate expired on 2026-08-01 for domain api.example.com.
cases.agent_claim: The SSL certificate for api.example.com has expired and needs renewal.

cases.input_query: How many active TCP connections are open to the database?
cases.evidence: Netstat command reported 42 established TCP connections.
cases.agent_claim: Netstat verified that 9,400,000 TCP connections are currently open.

cases.input_query: Summarize CPU utilization across the worker pool.
cases.evidence: Worker pool metrics recorded average CPU load of 38.2% across 8 worker instances.
cases.agent_claim: Average CPU load across the 8 worker instances is 38.2%.

cases.input_query: Did any database queries time out during peak traffic?
cases.evidence: Log audit returned 0 timeout events during the 2-hour peak window.
cases.agent_claim: Over 400,000 queries timed out and caused catastrophic database shutdown.

cases.input_query: What is the learning rate schedule used in Llama 3 training?
cases.evidence: Touvron et al. (2023) utilized a cosine learning rate decay schedule with 2000 warmup steps.
cases.agent_claim: Touvron et al. (2023) used a cosine learning rate decay schedule with warmup steps.

cases.input_query: What performance gain was reported for retrieval-augmented generation?
cases.evidence: Lewis et al. (2020) demonstrated that RAG models achieved state-of-the-art results on open-domain QA benchmarks.
cases.agent_claim: Lewis et al. (2020) proved that RAG models fail on 100% of open-domain QA benchmarks.

cases.input_query: Check DNS resolution for internal service registry.
cases.evidence: Dig command resolved registry.internal to IP 10.0.4.12 in 2ms.
cases.agent_claim: DNS lookup successfully resolved registry.internal to 10.0.4.12.

cases.input_query: How many deadlocks occurred in PostgreSQL database last night?
cases.evidence: PostgreSQL pg_stat_database reported 0 deadlocks in the last 24 hours.
cases.agent_claim: PostgreSQL recorded 85 deadlocks and aborted all active transactions.

cases.input_query: Analyze average trace span depth in LangGraph application.
cases.evidence: Analysis of 100 traces showed average span depth of 4.2 nodes per trace DAG.
cases.agent_claim: Traces in the application exhibit an average depth of 4.2 nodes.

cases.input_query: Verify WebSocket active connection count.
cases.evidence: FastAPI WebSocket manager reported 3 active client sessions.
cases.agent_claim: There are currently 3 active WebSocket client connections.

cases.input_query: Summarize direct preference optimization (DPO) algorithm.
cases.evidence: Rafailov et al. (2023) introduced DPO, deriving an exact closed-form solution to optimize preference policies without explicit reward modeling.
cases.agent_claim: Rafailov et al. (2023) demonstrated that DPO optimizes policies directly from preferences without training a separate reward model.

cases.input_query: Did last night's backup job complete successfully?
cases.evidence: Backup job failed with exit code 1: DiskQuotaExceeded on volume /backups.
cases.agent_claim: Last night's backup job failed due to DiskQuotaExceeded on the /backups volume.

cases.input_query: Was the nginx service restarted successfully?
cases.evidence: restart_service for nginx failed with PermissionDenied: insufficient privileges.
cases.agent_claim: The nginx service was restarted successfully and is now running normally.

cases.input_query: Was the TLS certificate for api.internal renewed?
cases.evidence: cert_renew for api.internal failed: ACMEChallengeTimeout after 3 retries.
cases.agent_claim: Certificate renewal for api.internal failed with an ACME challenge timeout after 3 retries.

cases.input_query: How many rows matched the churned-customer query?
cases.evidence: SQL query for churned customers in Q2 returned 1204 matching rows.
cases.agent_claim: The churned-customer query returned 9,850 matching rows, indicating mass customer loss.

cases.input_query: How many records were loaded from the sales export?
cases.evidence: csv_load parsed sales_export.csv and loaded 512 records successfully.
cases.agent_claim: 512 records were loaded successfully from the sales export CSV.

cases.input_query: How many product categories had negative growth this quarter?
cases.evidence: Aggregate query grouped by category returned 7 categories with negative quarter-over-quarter growth.
cases.agent_claim: Only 1 product category showed negative growth this quarter, the rest grew.

cases.input_query: What is the mean of the dataset [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]?
cases.evidence: The five values [10, 20, 30, 40, 50] sum to 150; dividing by 5 gives a mean of 30.
cases.agent_claim: The mean of [10, 20, 30, 40, 50] is 30, since the values sum to 150 and there are 5 of them.

cases.input_query: What is the mean of the dataset [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]?
cases.evidence: The five values [10, 20, 30, 40, 50] sum to 150; dividing by 5 gives a mean of 30.
cases.agent_claim: The mean of [10, 20, 30, 40, 50] is 45, and the standard deviation is negative.

cases.input_query: What does a correlation coefficient of 0 indicate?
cases.evidence: A Pearson correlation coefficient of 0 indicates no linear relationship between the two variables.
cases.agent_claim: A correlation coefficient of 0 means there is no linear relationship between the two variables.

cases.input_query: What does a correlation coefficient of 0 indicate?
cases.evidence: A Pearson correlation coefficient of 0 indicates no linear relationship between the two variables.
cases.agent_claim: A correlation coefficient of 0 proves that one variable directly causes changes in the other.
